name: Tavèrnoles (Spain)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and white with a black pale at the hoist charged with the yellow ploughshare of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 28 December 2012 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6295 of 17 January 2013; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, horizontal bicolour yellow and white, with a black pale 7/27 of the length at the hoist charged at the centre with the ploughshare of the arms.

features.role: ploughshare (rella) of the arms, 11/18 of the height
